patterns: APPSC asks single facts: smallest ocean = Arctic, largest = Pacific, oil on continental shelf, bathymetry = sea-floor mapping, hypsometric curve shows bottom topography.
APPSC G2 2023 used a match of shelf/slope/deep-sea plain/deeps with features, and a salinity ranking (Lake Van > Dead Sea > Great Salt Lake).
APPSC G1 2024 tested terrigenous deposits with a trap: coarseness does NOT increase seaward.
Other PSCs: Ninety East Ridge = Indian Ocean, Telegraph Plateau = North Atlantic, Diamantina = Indian Ocean, Mariana deepest, deep sea plains most extensive.
App MCQs track these closely; extra depth on temperature distribution and Deep Ocean Mission is reasonable.
